en_US.plugin_description: Search images on Unsplash and set them as wallpaper
en_US.setting_access_key_tooltip: Get this from [https://unsplash.com/developers](https://unsplash.com/developers): sign in, create an application, open the app details, and copy Access Key. Keep it private.
en_US.setting_results_per_page_tooltip: Number of Unsplash photos to show, from 1 to 30.
en_US.setting_download_dir_tooltip: Optional. Leave empty to use the platform cache directory.
en_US.result_access_key_subtitle: Open Unsplash Developers, create an app, then paste the Access Key in plugin settings.
en_US.result_access_key_preview:
Unsplash Access Key is required.

1. Open https://unsplash.com/developers.
2. Sign in or create an Unsplash account.
3. Create a new application.
4. Open the application details and copy the Access Key.
5. Paste it into this plugin's access_key setting.

Do not commit or share your Access Key.
en_US.query_requirement_access_key_required: Unsplash Access Key is required before searching wallpapers.
en_US.result_use_search_command_subtitle: Type unsplash search ocean to search Unsplash wallpapers.
en_US.result_search_subtitle: Type a keyword after search, such as unsplash search ocean.
en_US.result_featured_loading_subtitle: The Unsplash wallpapers cache is empty. It refreshes in the background; try again in a few seconds.

zh_CN.plugin_description: 搜索 Unsplash 图片并设置为桌面壁纸
zh_CN.setting_access_key_tooltip: 从 [https://unsplash.com/developers](https://unsplash.com/developers) 获取：登录后创建应用，打开应用详情，复制 Access Key。请勿分享或提交该密钥。
zh_CN.setting_results_per_page_tooltip: 显示的 Unsplash 图片数量，范围 1 到 30。
zh_CN.setting_orientation_tooltip: 首选 Unsplash 图片方向。
zh_CN.setting_content_filter_tooltip: Unsplash 内容安全过滤级别。
zh_CN.setting_download_dir_tooltip: 可选。留空时使用系统缓存目录。
zh_CN.result_access_key_subtitle: 打开 Unsplash Developers 创建应用，然后把 Access Key 填入插件设置。
zh_CN.result_access_key_preview:
需要配置 Unsplash Access Key。

1. 打开 https://unsplash.com/developers。
2. 登录或注册 Unsplash 账号。
3. 创建一个新的应用。
4. 打开应用详情并复制 Access Key。
5. 将它粘贴到本插件的 access_key 设置中。

请勿提交或分享你的 Access Key。
zh_CN.query_requirement_access_key_required: 搜索壁纸前需要先配置 Unsplash Access Key。
zh_CN.result_use_search_command_subtitle: 输入 unsplash search ocean 来搜索 Unsplash 壁纸。
zh_CN.result_search_subtitle: 请在 search 后输入关键词，例如 unsplash search ocean。
zh_CN.result_featured_loading_subtitle: Unsplash 壁纸缓存为空。插件会在后台刷新，请稍后再试。
